scope: Coordinator onboarding, organization registration, MFA enforcement and recovery
environment: Disposable local PostgreSQL, restricted runtime grants, real HTTP handlers and React components; synthetic Auth0 identities and redirects

findings.title: Auth0 SDK interaction-required errors leave registration in a retry loop
findings.trigger: getAccessTokenSilently rejects with login_required, mfa_required or consent_required before an API request
findings.observed: Refresh status clears the application and displays 'We couldn’t complete this request. Please try again.' No verification or sign-in-again button appears. Repeating Refresh status reproduces the failure.
findings.impact: Coordinator cannot continue registration through the displayed retry control. Logout/login remains available; saved server data is preserved. No privilege bypass or data loss was observed.
findings.recommendation: Recognize Auth0 SDK error codes separately from backend authorization errors and offer interactive authentication with the registration return route while preserving the draft.
findings.resolution: Coordinator signup and workspace normalize Auth0 SDK interaction errors into explicit recovery prompts. Registration returns to its own route and retains an unsubmitted form in account-scoped session storage. Ordinary network failures remain retryable errors. Backend MFA enforcement is unchanged.

verified: Duplicate application and organization prevention, response-loss retry, independent approval and invitation replay
No organization creation without completed MFA; application submission before staff MFA remains permitted by design
Missing, malformed, future, stale and metadata-only MFA claims fail closed
Five-minute write freshness and twelve-hour read freshness, including exact boundaries
Fresh tokens do not renew expired authentication or MFA timestamps
Blocked and pre-revocation staff tokens are denied even with fresh MFA claims
Browser draft survives actual PrivateSession remount around a simulated MFA redirect
Expired code-creation verification recovers after fresh MFA without reapproval
limits: No real Auth0 phone enrollment, OTP verification, recovery-code redemption or signed-token callback was performed
No current tenant configuration was revalidated; local Action implementations were exercised
Stress HTTP fixture bypasses JWT signature verification to inject controlled identities; this is not a JWT-verifier audit
No production resources, accounts, provider traffic or deployment configuration were changed
Previously reported binder-sharing concurrency findings are separate and remain unfixed
